summary.text: Jay Edwards is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 70 since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as John Edwards, gives his profession as operations manager at Advanced Building Concepts.

paragraphs.text: Edwards earned a B.S. in political science from Northeastern University in 1983.

His professional experience includes work as superintendent of J.G. Edwards Construction Company from 1989 to 1998, as a project manager for O. Ahlborg and Sons from 1998 to 2000, as senior project manager for Hodess Building Company from 2000 to 2003, and for Cutler Associates from 2003 to 2006, and he has been operations manager at Advanced Building Concepts since 2006.
He served on the Tiverton town council from 2006 to 2008.
